Ria (Support): FYI incoming request from Acme — they want a temporary burst uplift from 60 r/s -> 600 r/s for 48h. Ticket: https://zendesk.example/52418. Can we triage for fraud and product?
Connor (Sales): They signed a POC MSA last week, pushing to demo tomorrow. Revenue signal strong but need risk check.
Jill - Product: Do we have a quick checklist for temporary rate uplift? What are launch/fallback criteria?
Alex P (SRE): Quick safety checks: 1) confirm API key owner & billing status 2) run automated abuse scan 3) temp proxy + sampling logs. I can run abuse check now.
Maya (Trust): @Alex P please run scan and post flags. Also check for IP churn and unusual user-agent patterns.
Alex P (SRE): Running: `curl -s -X POST https://internal-api/redwood/abuse-check -d \"ticket=52418\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\"`
Alex P (SRE): Scan output (truncated):
```
{
  "signals": {
    "new_account": true,
    "rapid_key_rotation": 3,
    "geo_spread": "US,CA,GB",
    "top_ip_volume": "10.2.3.4: 45%"
  },
  "score": 0.62,
  "recommendation": "manual_review"
}
```
FraudBot: Auto-check: confidence=0.62, flagged=manual_review, reasons=[new_account, rotation, single-ip-hotspot] :eyes:
Ria (Support): Thanks. Customer claims critical ingest for demo. Sales requests temporary uplift while manual review runs.
Jill - Product: Product side: if we grant temporary uplift it needs clear rollback, monitoring, and SLO guardrails. Proposed criteria: 1) sampling of 10% requests logged 2) latency < 800ms p95 3) automatic throttle back to 60 r/s on anomaly.
Connor (Sales): Can we do a scoped uplift — only for specific API key + CIDR ranges? That should reduce blast radius.
Alex P (SRE): Yes — propose scoped policy: key-level cap 600 r/s, IP whitelisting to customer CIDRs, per-IP limit 200 r/s, and 5m moving-average anomaly detection. I can push policy via admin feature flag.
Maya (Trust): Assigning manual analyst to ticket 52418: @Zane will take it, ETA 45m. If Zane confirms low risk we can approve interim uplift with monitoring. If not, deny.
Ria (Support): I'll respond to customer: propose conditional uplift pending manual review, and provide fallback plan.
Jill - Product: I'll convert this into a short product request for the backlog: \"temporary scoped rate uplifts with automatic rollback and sampling\" — include acceptance criteria + security signoff. Priority: P1 for field demo risk.
Connor (Sales): Appreciate it. If manual review clears, can we extend from 48h -> 72h? Need to know process for extension.
Jill - Product: Extensions need re-approval from Trust + Prod; we'll add that to the PRD checklist.
Alex P (SRE): Action items: 1) run scoped policy (I'll deploy flag) 2) enable 10% request logging -> /secure-logs 3) set anomaly alert to #incidents.
Maya (Trust): Action items: 1) Zane to complete manual review (45m) 2) escalate to TrustOps if any hard signals 3) post final decision back here.
Ria (Support): I'll update ticket and ping customer with conditional approval language.
Connor (Sales): Sounds good — ping me when uplift is live so I can confirm demo readiness. :thumbsup:
Jill - Product: I'll file the backlog ticket and link it here once created.
Ria (Support): Thanks team. Keeping thread open until decision.
